title: Create: Dynamic Village — chest loot assignment
description: Assigns a loot table to a building's chests. Place at data/<ns>/dynamicvillage/loot/<structure_path>.json, where the file's own id mirrors the structure it applies to (structure ns:path -> file data/ns/dynamicvillage/loot/path.json).

loot_table.description: Loot table id stamped onto the building's chests, e.g. dynamicvillage:chests/village/miner or minecraft:chests/village/village_plains_house.

override_existing.description: If true, also replace chests that were hand-authored with their own loot table. Default false preserves authored chests.

conditions.description: Optional load conditions; ALL must be met or this assignment is skipped.
